chunks: And it is narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās that he said:

I heard the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say to ʿAlī عليه السلام: “O ʿAlī, you are my legatee; I have entrusted to you by the command of my Lord, and you are my successor; I have appointed you as successor by the command of my Lord. O ʿAlī, you are the one who will make clear to my Ummah that wherein they differ after me, and you will stand among them in my place. Your word is my word, your command is my command, obedience to you is obedience to me, and obedience to me is obedience to Allah; and disobedience to you is disobedience to me, and disobedience to me is disobedience to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.بِأَمْرِ رَبِّي: by the command of my Lord, indicating divine appointment
key_terms.تَقُومُ فِيهِمْ مَقَامِي: you stand among them in my place
key_terms.تُبَيِّنُ لِأُمَّتِي: you make clear for my community, referring to authoritative clarification
key_terms.خَلِيفَتِي: my successor, the one appointed to stand after the Prophet
key_terms.طَاعَتُكَ طَاعَتِي: obedience to you is obedience to me
key_terms.مَعْصِيَتُكَ مَعْصِيَتِي: disobedience to you is disobedience to me
key_terms.وَصِيِّي: my legatee, the one entrusted with the Prophet’s bequest and authority

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as the Prophet’s successor and authority after him?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم explicitly addressing Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as his wasi and khalifah by the command of Allah. It describes Imam ʿAlī’s role in clarifying matters of disagreement for the Ummah after the Prophet and equates obedience to him with obedience to the Prophet and to Allah.
